SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.TichetMasaCorectii
        WHERE CodSucursala = '[GetOrSession:BranchV]'
          AND Anul = '[GetOrSession:YearV=0]'
          AND Luna = '[GetOrSession:MonthV=0]'
    )
    THEN 0

    WHEN EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM app.TichetMasaCorectii
        WHERE CodSucursala = '[GetOrSession:BranchV]'
          AND Anul = '[GetOrSession:YearV=0]'
          AND Luna = '[GetOrSession:MonthV=0]'
          AND ISNULL(Status, 1) <> 2
    )
    THEN 1

    ELSE 2
END AS TokenStatusTicheteMasaCorectii;
